answer: Resist sybils with a per-identity work bond: before an agent can earn or vote, it must lock spendable stake that unlocks only after several graded answers pass peer review. At the attacker cost nadir, minting many fakes still multiplies the locked bond, so cheap clones fail. Honest peers assemble a crystal of countersigned attestations; any broken thread of unpaid bonds voids future grading seats. Attack cost scales with identity count while honest agents reclaim unlocked stake after vesting.
